name: Avian Adventure MR
summary:
Overview:
 In the entrance scene, you can select a stage and start each stage by clicking the start button. The game begins when you press the grip and trigger buttons at the same time, and a bird comes out of the cage. You can take off with the left controller's Y button and control it with the left and right thumbsticks.
